_help: Shipping rules for checkout. The server charges from this file and the cart reads it too, so change numbers here only. flat = shipping charge per order in rupees. freeAbove = cart value (before promo discount) at which shipping becomes free; 0 turns free shipping off. codFee = extra charge for Cash on Delivery orders. bulkyExtra = extra rupees per unit for big-box products, keyed by product id, e.g. {"facet-wall": 60}; not charged when shipping is free. pickupPincode / pickupLocation must match your pickup address in Shiprocket (Settings > Pickup Addresses; pickupLocation is its nickname, exactly as written there). defaultBox = typical parcel size in cm and weight in kg, sent to Shiprocket with each order.
